title: Analyst Memorandum — Measuring the Saved Electricity of a True-Up Period, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Measuring the Saved Electricity of a True-Up Period

Memorandum of the analyst group on the electricity a true-up period is taken to have saved on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The measure turns on how often the tier trues measured savings up.

## Rule

- Where the tier trues measured savings up once a year, the saved electricity is the baseline standing on the subscription less the electricity the period's readings recorded over the twelve months ending on the day of the verification, and never less than nothing.
- Where the tier trues measured savings up half-yearly, it is half the baseline less the electricity those readings recorded over the six months ending on that day, taken twice and never less than nothing.
- Where the tier trues measured savings up every quarter or not at all, it is a quarter of the baseline less the electricity those readings recorded over the three months ending on that day, taken four times and never less than nothing.

## Table

| True-up frequency fixed for the tier | Share of the baseline compared | Window of the period's readings | Multiplier on the difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| annual | the whole baseline | 12 months ending on the day of the verification | once |
| semiannual | half the baseline | 6 months ending on that day | twice |
| quarterly, or none | a quarter of the baseline | 3 months ending on that day | four times |

In every limb the difference is held at nothing where it would fall below nothing, and the readings gathered are those posted from the utility bills, placed in the window by the day they were posted.

## Cases (hypothetical, baseline 1 200 000 kilowatt hours)

*Annual, 1 090 000 kilowatt hours recorded over 12 months.* 1200000 less 1090000, that is 110 000 kilowatt hours saved.

*Half-yearly, 560 000 recorded over 6 months.* Half the baseline is 600000; less 560000 leaves 40000; taken twice, 80 000 kilowatt hours.

*Quarterly, 320 000 recorded over 3 months.* A quarter of the baseline is 300000; less 320000 falls below nothing, so nothing is saved.
